status: Fictional shared exercise benchmark; see documented assumptions and limitations.
hourly_year_role: historical stress and screening year; not a future price forecast
load_boundary: total facility AC demand including cooling; do not multiply by PUE
money_basis: 2023 USD benchmark; contract prices and adders are fictional in the same dollar basis
grid_access_note: Fictional campus import limit; all offsite resources share it. Not confirmed utility service.
reliability_scope: hourly adequacy only; UPS and emergency protection outside scope
storage_charge_rule: only from clean portfolio generation; no grid/fossil charging or storage-to-storage transfers
preferences: Teams design input and recommendation logic; objective weights are not prescribed.
emissions_metric_note: Attributable screening CO2 indicator, not a site-specific physical inventory or marginal avoided emissions.
gas_connection_note: Gas turbine, gas engine and natural-gas fuel cell assume delivered fuel infrastructure is ready at each resource available_month. Dates are hypothetical offers, not installation-speed or gas-connection forecasts.
price_geography_note: LZ_SOUTH is a regional ERCOT price proxy, not a verified Williamson County settlement point.
load_tier_boundary: Net local facility AC demand, including allocated cooling. Essential infrastructure remains protected. No extra PUE multiplier.
nuclear_note: Hypothetical physical delivery from a new offsite plant available at month 60; 25 MW maximum and 95 USD/MWh are fictional case offers, not supplier quotations or a nuclear project-cost forecast.
time_convention: 120 equal model months of730hours. Month0 starts at model_hour0. Year1 is months0..11. No future calendar/DST forecast implied; reference_hour=model_hour%8760.
profile_repetition: Repeat the same 2023 reference year 10 times for hourly shape, including stress windows and price/renewable coincidence. Merchant wholesale price, Henry Hub gas price and grid CO2 follow the smooth real-terms path in data/price_trajectory.json (constant 2023 USD). No weather diversification, demand randomness or probability implied.
cost_start_rule: For each selected resource, charges and availability begin at max(initial_service_month,available_month). Capacity is selected upfront and remains committed through horizon end.
cost_comparison: Sum common annualized capacity charges prorated by operating hours plus energy/response charges; no second discounting or terminal value. This is a cumulative screening cost, NOT project NPV.
commitment_rule: No retirement, resale, cancellation, replacements or optional retirement credits in core model. All lives exceed ten-year horizon.
land_boundary: 8 usable acres reserved for selectable onsite energy infrastructure, including resource-associated access/clearances in footprint factors. Campus buildings, ordinary cooling, shared utility substation/roads and emergency UPS/protection accommodated separately; no solar/wind field onsite.
storage_boundary_rule: SOC0 before hour0; continuous across months/years; finalSOC0 at horizon end. Annual equivalent-cycle ceiling for each8760-hour model year, prorated by resource available hours in that year.
grid_delay_rule: grid_delay_months is a nonnegative integer in submission metadata, zero for required base comparison; shift all positive milestones by this amount. Other resource dates unchanged.
initial_service_range: Integer initial_service_month >=14 and initial_service_month+10<120 (maximum109); default20. Month30 full-demand target can be a preference or hard deadline.
clean_only_battery_note: Common attribution convention, not physical battery restriction.
land_footprint_note: Engine and fuel-cell equipment footprints use manufacturer context but remain fictional allowances, not engineered site layouts.
